config.objective: Assess overall multi-objective EMER+Jev benefit within the existing real-score cohort without new paid inference
config.data: All36000 audited Apr19-21 development slates; 252000 existing native JEV-27B judgments; never read Apr23-25 confirmation data
config.outer_assignment: First8 bytes of SHA256('outer|partition_seed|user_id'), big-endian, modulo3; one fold per user
config.inner_assignment: Among non-test users, first8 SHA256 bytes for 'inner-{outer_fold}|partition_seed|user_id', big-endian, modulo5 equals0 selects validation; all others train

training.selection: Each arm/outer-fold/seed independently maximizes weighted inner-validation mean of six positive NDCG@3 goals; earliest config/epoch ties; epoch0 allowed
training.weight_initialization: Fresh from the same seed in both arms for every fold; no reused trained reranker weights

config.features: Recompute encoding moments from the fold's training candidates only. Behavior model remains frozen at its pre-Apr19 checkpoint. Native Jev inputs and outcomes unchanged.

evaluation.outer_predictions: Each row receives predictions only from models whose train and inner-validation users exclude that row's user
evaluation.evaluate_after: All72 fits and every inner-only selection are frozen before any outer-fold performance calculation
evaluation.evidence_screen: Pooled primary difference lower conditional user-bootstrap interval>0; primary point gain>0 for each fixed seed and each outer fold; all seven point guards pass
evaluation.uncertainty: Conditional paired-user summaries of the fitted out-of-fold predictions; folds have overlapping training sets and are not independent replicates; not a universal unbiased CV variance estimate

limitations: Retrospective evaluation on an already explored cohort; not a pristine prospective confirmation or replacement of the frozen Apr23-25 test.
User-disjoint for reranker fitting and selection, not a claim these users never appeared in the earlier frozen behavior model.
Cross-user generalization within Apr19-21, not new-date generalization or online causal uplift.

scope: Retrospective nested user holdouts; not new chronological confirmation
